title: Filtering the products table by numbers · part 20

steps.title: Filter then sort: price <= 21.39
steps.prompt:
Filter first, then ORDER BY tidies what is left.
LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price <= 21.39 ORDER BY price LIMIT 3;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add WHERE price <= 21.39.
Add ORDER BY price LIMIT 3.
Write: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price <= 21.39 ORDER BY price LIMIT 3;

steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
